sehemu: Part VII: Special Constitutional Court of the United Republic
jina: Composition of the Special Constitutional Court
maudhui: (1) The Special Constitutional Court shall consist of members of whom one half of the total number shall be appointed by the Government of the United Republic and the other half shall be appointed by the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar. (2) A person may be appointed a member of the Special Constitutional Court only if he is or has been a Justice of Appeal, a Judge of the High Court of the United Republic or of the High Court of Zanzibar, or is a person with the ability and experience of a Judge and is qualified for appointment as a Judge or Acting Judge under the law applicable in Mainland Tanzania or the law applicable in Tanzania Zanzibar, as the case may be. (3) A person may be appointed a member of the Special Constitutional Court for the purpose of hearing one matter only or two or more matters as they arise. A member shall continue to exercise the functions of his office until the matter concerned is concluded, his appointment is revoked, or he becomes unable to perform his functions by reason of illness or any other cause.

(3) A person may be appointed a member of the Special Constitutional Court for the purpose of hearing one matter only or two or more matters as they arise.
